documents_expected.why: call page: who can apply, how to apply, rolling intake
program guide 2026/27: eligible and ineligible projects, 80% cap, process

eligibility.rule: Registered non-profits, local governments and First Nations in the Columbia Basin Trust region
eligibility.quote: Eligible applicants include registered non-profits, local governments and First Nations in the Columbia Basin Trust region.

eligibility.rule: Applicants outside the Basin must partner with a Basin community organisation
eligibility.quote: Applicants operating outside the Basin must partner with community-based organizations operating within the region and must show that the project benefits the Basin.

eligibility.rule: On-the-ground action, not only research, education or planning
eligibility.quote: have on-the-ground action (rather than strictly research, education or planning) to support ecological health and resilience at a local level that yield meaningful and measurable benefits;

eligibility.rule: On crown, local government, First Nations or conservation land; not private land, BC Hydro/Fortis land or parks
eligibility.quote: take place on crown land, local government land, First Nations land, or conservation land;
alt_quotes: take place on personally or commercially held private land, BC Hydro or Fortis land, or Provincial/Federal Parks;

eligibility.quote: aim to be completed within two years;
include an effectiveness monitoring component to help understand how the project implementation is achieving its intended outcomes and goals

eligibility.rule: Shovel-ready: planning and permitting progress shown
eligibility.quote: demonstrate progress in completing necessary planning, permitting and project development activities that will make the project shovel-ready;

eligibility.rule: No restoration of damage from identifiable industrial or commercial development
eligibility.quote: This includes any restoration related to habitat fragmentation or other negative ecosystem impacts that have occurred because of identifiable industrial or commercial development or access

documents.item: Full online application, by invitation after an enquiry
documents.quote: If your project meets the program criteria, you will be invited to submit an online application.

effort.step: Email ecosystems@ourtrust.org to discuss the project idea
effort.quote: Contact ecosystems@ourtrust.org to enquire about your project. Eligible projects will be invited to apply and sent an application form.

effort.step: If invited, submit the full application (rolling, until funds run out)
effort.quote: Applications are accepted on a first-received, first-served basis and are assessed as they come in and continue until all funding for the program has been committed.

effort.step: Sign the Contribution Agreement before funds flow
effort.quote: To finalize funding, both parties will sign a Contribution Agreement. Funds will be received after both parties sign the Agreement.

co_finance_required.quote: The application should clearly demonstrate that at least 20% of total project costs will be received from sources other than the Trust

notes: Up to 80% of costs, typically at most $80,000 per project; an optional wage subsidy covers 50% of one technician's wage. No deadline: rolling intake until funds are committed. No report duty is published; the contribution agreement may set one.
